meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: Claude 会分析你报告的 bug，自动定位到正确的 GitHub 仓库（code-yeongyu/lazycodex 或 openai/codex），生成包含标题、环境、复现步骤、根因和修复建议的 Issue 或 PR，并添加 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交、打开或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发，特别是需要基于源码的根因分析和 GitHub 路由。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 提一个 bug，安装后插件不显示。
say.note: Claude 会分析并创建 Issue。

say.text: 报告一个 Codex CLI 的 bug，复现步骤是…
say.note: Claude 会定位仓库并创建 Issue。

say.text: 在 openai/codex 创建一个 Issue，关于技能名称显示问题。
say.note: Claude 会检查是否重复后创建。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your bug report, determines the correct repository (code-yeongyu/lazycodex or openai/codex), and generates a GitHub Issue or PR with title, environment, reproduction steps, root cause, and fix suggestions, labeled lazycodex-generated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when source-backed root cause and GitHub routing are needed.

say_en.text: File a bug for LazyCodex: plugin not showing after install.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and creates an Issue.

say_en.text: Report a Codex CLI bug: reproduction steps are...
say_en.note: Claude routes and creates an Issue.

say_en.text: Create an Issue in openai/codex about skill name display.
say_en.note: Claude checks for duplicates before creating.
